description: This file defines the GatewayConfig interface, which provides configuration settings for the Gateway service, including HTTP, caching, streaming, health checks, command handling, messaging, authentication, and public health endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for the Gateway service, extending ServiceSpecificConfig and WithProtocolConfig, with methods to retrieve various configuration components.

methods.name: getHttpConfig
methods.description: Returns the HTTP configuration settings for the Gateway.

methods.name: getCachesConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for the Gateway.

methods.name: getStreamingConfig
methods.description: Returns the streaming configuration for the Gateway, including WebSocket settings.

methods.name: getHealthCheckConfig
methods.description: Returns the health check configuration for the Gateway.

methods.name: getCommandConfig
methods.description: Returns the command configuration for the Gateway, introduced in version 1.1.0.

methods.name: getMessageConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the '/messages' endpoint.

methods.name: getClaimMessageConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the '/inbox/claim' endpoint.

methods.name: getAuthenticationConfig
methods.description: Returns the authentication configuration for the Gateway.

methods.name: getPublicHealthConfig
methods.description: Returns the public health endpoint configuration.
